description.en-US: Declared here rather than inherited from core.basemodel.base_model, because that mixin carries the tenant key and this table must not be tenant-scoped. A module's setting declarations are the same for every tenant: registration runs once at start-up with no tenant in scope, and a tenant column would force one duplicate row per tenant of identical data. Only the VALUES in settings_records are per-tenant.

The module that owns this schema, matching its Name(). Immutable: re-pointing a schema at another module would orphan every record copied from it, since a record carries the module_key it was created under.

Which kind of owner this schema's settings belong to. A module registers at most one schema per level, which is what the unique index enforces. Immutable: the records built from it already carry this level, and changing it here would leave them describing a level their schema no longer declares.

The module's setting definitions as a model-schema document, parsed and validated by the same engine that handles every other schema. It is metadata-only and must not declare should_build_db: the only tables settings builds are its own two. Each field's metadata may declare a starting allow_override, which applies until a tenant admin rules otherwise; the decision itself is stored on settings_records.
